questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解答} \ \int_{0}^{2\pi} \left| \sin x \right| dx & = \int_{0}^{\pi} \sin x \, dx + \int_{\pi}^{2\pi} \left( -\sin x \right) dx \, d\phi \\ & = -\cos x \left| \begin{matrix} \pi \\ 0 \end{matrix} + \cos x \right| \left| \begin{matrix} 2\pi \\ \pi \end{matrix} \right| = 2 + 2 = 4. \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答（4）,（B）的积分函数在[-1,1]上是偶函数，其积分值不为零.}\\&\text{而}\int_{-\pi}^{2\pi}\cos^{5}x\,dx=\int_{-\pi}^{2\pi}\left(1-\sin^{2}x\right)^{2}d\sin x\\&=\int_{-\pi}^{2\pi}\left(1-2\sin^{2}x+\sin^{4}x\right)d\left(\sin x\right)\\&=\left(\sin x-\frac{2}{3}\sin^{3}x+\frac{1}{5}\sin^{5}x\right)\bigg|_{-\pi}^{2\pi}=0\,,\mid\\&\text{而}\int_{-\pi}^{2\pi}\sin^{5}x\,dx=\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}\sin^{5}x\,dx+\int_{\pi}^{2\pi}\sin^{5}x\,dx\\&=0+\int_{\pi}^{2\pi}\sin^{5}x\,dx\\&\overset{\frac{d}{dx}x=\pi+t}{\underset{dx=dt}{=}}\int_{0}^{\pi}\sin^{5}t\,dt=-2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin^{5}t\,dt=-2\times\frac{4}{5}+\frac{2}{3}=-\frac{16}{15}.\end{aligned}
